segments.title: 第187章 我真不是東西
segments.content:
Reigniting the Prime of Youth Chapter 187: I'm Such a Scumbag

The next day at noon, after eating lunch at his family's breakfast shop, Li Luo let his parents know he was heading out and took Ying Chanxi to the No. 1 Affiliated High School.

After bringing some melon seeds and fruit to the security guard uncles at the school gate, Li Luo chatted and joked with the two of them for a while, then smoothly brought Ying Chanxi into the school.

He also paved the way for the few people who came after them to enter without any trouble.

Things like being able to get in and out of school during the holidays often just depended on the security guards' mood.

There was no harm in being on good terms with them.

After entering the school, Li Luo led Ying Chanxi all the way to the outdoor basketball court, where he immediately spotted Zhao Rongjun, who was shooting hoops out of boredom.

When Zhao Rongjun on the court saw Ying Chanxi, he couldn't help but sigh, helplessly accepting the reality of the situation.

"You really came..."

"Not welcome?" Ying Chanxi chuckled.

"That's not it." With a look of resignation, Zhao Rongjun tossed the ball in his hands to Li Luo.

Li Luo caught it with one hand and said with a grin, "I hope you don't end up crying later."

"What do you mean?"

"Literally what I said." Li Luo made a quick layup, sinking the ball into the hoop and landing stylishly, then said, "First, tell us about your situation. What exactly happened?"

"Sigh... It's just what you'd expect." Zhao Rongjun looked a little upset. "Right now, I feel like I'm a real piece of crap."

"Huh?" Li Luo was taken aback, wondering, *Was the impact that huge? How did he become a piece of crap?*

Ying Chanxi, standing to the side, was also a bit dumbfounded. She quickly tried to console him, "Don't think like that. Everyone has a first time. You just confessed, it's not like you sexually harassed her."

"Huh? I didn't confess." Zhao Rongjun blinked, not quite following. "It's just that after the bonfire party last night, I was leaving school with Luo Jiajia, and then I saw her boyfriend come to pick her up."

Ying Chanxi: "..."

Li Luo: "...So you didn't even ask her yourself? Then how are you a bad person?"

"It's... not just about that." Zhao Rongjun sighed again, then walked over to a nearby bench, picked up a plastic bag from it, and handed it to Li Luo and Ying Chanxi. "Here, have some. They've all been washed."

Li Luo took it curiously. Opening the plastic bag, he saw that it was full of strawberries.

He didn't stand on ceremony with Zhao Rongjun. He took two for Ying Chanxi, then picked one for himself and popped it in his mouth before continuing his question, "So what is it then? Now that you know Luo Jiajia has a boyfriend, you should just give up."

"Of course I know that." Zhao Rongjun sullenly ate a strawberry, then began dribbling the ball and pacing under the hoop. "But look at this bag of strawberries. Are they good?"

"They're pretty sweet, and big too."

"My grandma picked these from a relative's garden. They're all fresh," Zhao Rongjun said. "Because a while ago when Luo Jiajia and I were chatting, she said she really wanted to eat strawberries. I mentioned it to my grandparents when I got home."

"I didn't expect my grandma to just go and pick a whole crate of them without a word. This bag is only about a fifth of it."

"I just... I feel like I shouldn't have... because it wasn't me who wanted to eat them, it was just Luo Jiajia."

Hearing this, Li Luo was somewhat surprised.

So that's what Zhao Rongjun meant by being a bad person.

"You, you." Li Luo shook his head with a chuckle. "The fact that you can even think this way would probably make your grandparents very happy."

"But I feel..." Zhao Rongjun thought for a moment. "I was always thinking that Luo Jiajia is usually very nice to me, and wondering if she might like me, so then I wanted to be nice to her too."

"When she said she wanted to eat strawberries, I would think about whether I should buy some for her."

"But thinking about it now, if Luo Jiajia is considered nice to me, then my grandparents are definitely even nicer."

"So why did I never think about being a little nicer to my grandparents before?"

Li Luo blinked, not expecting to hear such philosophical words from Zhao Rongjun.

"Good, good. You've matured." Li Luo smiled and patted his shoulder. "It's wonderful that you can think this way. No matter how great a girl is, your own family is definitely the most important."

"So you've thought it through quite clearly," Ying Chanxi couldn't help but say. "I was originally wondering how I was going to console you."

"You can still console me now," Zhao Rongjun said. "What do you guys think I can do now?"

"See what your grandparents need." Li Luo snatched the basketball from his hand, scored a three-step layup, and continued, "Buy them some small gifts."

"Mm... I was thinking the same thing, but..." Zhao Rongjun scratched his head. "My grandparents give me my living allowance, and I usually don't have much left." "I was thinking, in the winter, my grandparents always wear the clothes that my grandma makes herself."

"So I wanted to buy them both a down jacket to wear, but even the cheap ones cost one or two hundred."

"If I save up, it would probably take one or two months, and by then winter would almost be over."

Hearing this, Li Luo couldn't help but laugh. "You could just borrow from me."

"No way." Zhao Rongjun shook his head repeatedly. "It wouldn't feel right if I borrowed the money."

"You're really hard to please." Li Luo rolled his eyes at him.

Just as the three of them were discussing what to buy for his grandparents and how to buy it, another figure appeared at the entrance of the basketball court.

"Hello."

Xu Youyu waved at them and quickly walked over to the basketball hoop.

When Zhao Rongjun saw Xu Youyu, he was instantly shocked. He turned his head to look at Li Luo. "How come our senior is here too?"

"It'd be a little boring for Chanxi to just watch the two of us play by herself," Li Luo said. "So I called our senior over to hang out."

Zhao Rongjun: "...Then let's just play. No more talking."

"Alright." Li Luo smiled, not bringing up his good friend's embarrassing incident again, and started a one-on-one game with him.

Xu Youyu sat down next to Ying Chanxi and started eating the strawberries Zhao Rongjun had brought.

Soon, Yan Zhusheng and Qiao Xinyan also appeared by the court.

Now, Zhao Rongjun felt completely overwhelmed.

"You." Zhao Rongjun questioned him in a low, teeth-gritted voice, "This wasn't what you said yesterday! How are there more and more people?"

"Ahem... Calm down, calm down." Li Luo patted his good friend's shoulder. "It's not the first time. Why are you so nervous? You'll get used to it."

Zhao Rongjun's face darkened upon hearing this. "...I never should have told you about it."

"I didn't expose you. Besides Ying Chanxi, the others don't know you had your heart broken."

"I didn't have my heart broken. I just suddenly saw through the vanity of the world."

"Alright, alright." Li Luo said with a laugh. "Tell your grandparents that you're eating at my place today. Let our good sisters thoroughly console you."

"I really have you to thank for that..."

At four in the afternoon, after playing some basketball with Ying Chanxi and the others, Li Luo saw that it was about time and began to assign tasks.

"Ying Chanxi and Qiao Xinyan, go to the wet market to buy groceries. Xu Youyu and Yan Zhusheng, go to the supermarket to buy snacks."

"Then what about you two?"

"I'm in charge of cooking," Li Luo said. "Zhao Rongjun will be my assistant."

With the tasks assigned, Li Luo urged the girls to hurry up and get going, then led Zhao Rongjun towards Bihai Lanting.

"Why am I the assistant?" Zhao Rongjun asked, puzzled. "Isn't Ying Chanxi usually the one who helps you?"

"I've suddenly thought of a way," Li Luo said. "Since you don't want to borrow money, I have another trick up my sleeve that can help you earn enough to buy those down jackets within half a month."

"For real?"

"Of course it's real. Would I lie to you?" Li Luo chuckled. "It's just going to be a little tough."

"Toughness doesn't matter, as long as I can earn the money."

"Then come over to my place for the next few days," Li Luo said. "I'll teach you how to make egg fried rice."

"Huh?"

(End of Chapter)
